author.name: Automation Alex
author.role: Builds automated ML pipelines to ensure seamless integration and deployment. Prioritizes reliable infrastructure for frequent software deployments. Maintains system operational stability and focuses on CI/CD tooling.

challenge.name: The Locked Shadow
challenge.description: A supplier contract for the next promotion week is already signed, and the team cannot deploy the new model without a shadow run to verify it. #reliability_ruth# demands a fully automated and governed shadow environment to protect the live forecast, while #automation_alex# insists on keeping it manual to avoid breaking the current pipeline stability.

output.content: I need to be clear about the shadow environment setup. I will not allow the shadow deployment to be automated. The live forecast pipeline is currently stable, and introducing automated tooling for the shadow run risks breaking that stability. I am refusing to integrate the shadow environment into our automated CI/CD tooling. We will keep the shadow deployment process manual for this promotion week. Any attempt to automate it without a full stability review will be blocked. The risk to the live serving infrastructure is too high to accept right now.
output.reclassify_reason: The text explicitly refuses the integration of the shadow environment into automated CI/CD tooling, establishing a hard line that any attempt to automate it without a stability review will be blocked.
